WP_STEPS|/planE/short: DIN 18533: W1.1-E, W1.2-E, W4-E or W2.1-E — the class sets the dry film thickness.
WP_STEPS|/planE/overview: The material rate depends on the required dry film thickness corresponding to the water impact class (material rate table of the technical data sheet). Ground moisture and non-pressurised water (W1.1-E, W1.2-E): ≥ 2.0 mm on concrete, ≥ 3.0 mm on masonry work; moderate pressing water ≤ 3 m (W2.1-E): ≥ 4.0 mm; splash water at the wall base (W4-E): ≥ 2.0 mm.
WP_STEPS|/planE/points/1: W1.1-E: highly permeable subsoil or back-filling, minimum 50 cm above the design water level; W1.2-E: water-logging avoided through drainage
WP_STEPS|/planE/points/2: W2.1-E: backwater or flood water up to 3 m; loose/fixed flange constructions or tested house entry systems for pipe penetrations
WP_STEPS|/planE/points/3: the waterproofing must be protected against weathering and mechanical damage in accordance with DIN 18533; drainage in accordance with DIN 4095
WP_STEPS|/prepE/short: Even, load-bearing, pore open, fully grouted; edges chamfered, corners rounded; depressions levelled; matt damp.
